title: ColorPicker
description: Fiori color picker with hue, alpha, hexadecimal and RGB/HSL channel inputs.

usage.summary: Choose an arbitrary color visually or enter its channel values.
useWhen: Let users choose a color beyond a predefined set of swatches.
Support visual selection and direct hexadecimal, RGB or HSL channel entry.
Use simplified when users need only visual selection and hexadecimal entry.

avoidWhen.when: Choose only predefined colors that stay visible in the page.
Choose predefined colors in an on-demand anchored chooser.
